stated_limits: X13/F3 (offset paging under a concurrent DELETE): the sum is over the rows present at read time, plus or minus one row per comparison deleted during the read. It is never a duplicate, because ascending order plus de-dup by id already makes a concurrent INSERT safe. Keyset pagination is the follow-up.

X13/F4: the owner must confirm once that the project's PostgREST max-rows setting is 1000 (Supabase dashboard: Settings -> API -> Max rows), and the PR body records the answer. A lower value would cap the read at one page with truncated False, a silent undercount.

X13/F5: the half-even 2-dp rounding of estimated_monthly_total was already there before this unit (round(30.00 + 0.005, 2) == 30.0). avg_cost_per_comparison / avg_cost_per_request_usd average over rows WITH a recorded cost, partial rows included, so the average is biased low when rows_partial > 0.

X13/F7: a camera FAILURE body (compare success False) carries the vision-only metadata.openai summary. With ENABLE_PAID_ROUTE_METERING ON (prod) it is never persisted. The OFF path was not executed here.

X13/E9: the /admin/costs month window keeps now().microsecond, so it starts up to 1 s into the month. This line is unchanged from main 4c0f3c99 and is a follow-up for when it is next touched, not this unit.

X13/E6 -> X6 (design adopted): when reading the usage raises after the ledger was obtained, the recorder now appends an UNPRICED entry (requested model; prompt/completion/cached/cost None). The call counts toward calls/unpriced_calls and makes cost_complete False instead of vanishing. The debug line keeps the exception TYPE NAME only. With the SDK's pydantic CompletionUsage this path is not expected to occur.

X2 contract (replaces the GREEN limit 'cost_complete present only when rows_partial > 0'): both admin endpoints ALWAYS carry cost_complete. It is None when no row recorded a cost, False when any row's own summary says cost_complete False, and True otherwise. Unknown wins over partial: a window whose only openai row is all-unpriced reads cost_complete None with rows_partial 1. An all-unpriced row counts in BOTH rows_without_cost and rows_partial, so rows_with_cost + rows_without_cost == rows while rows_partial overlaps both.
The GREEN limit 'an OPENAI_MODEL_* override to an unpriced id makes every row partial' is now true even when EVERY call of a row is unpriced, because such rows are partial as well as without-cost.

costs.html renders the endpoint's note verbatim through innerHTML. The note is a server constant, pure ASCII, on an admin-only page. If an older backend omits note, the card's sub-label is empty: the static 'free daily allowance' sentence was replaced, as X1 says.
- The ledger is per request: a ContextVar bound at each compare entry, plus the camera route's own ledger. A fire-and-forget task's append after the summary was taken is never re-summarised.
- Rows persisted before the deploy carry no metadata.openai and read as rows_without_cost.
- The price table is the owner's 2026-10-08 snapshot with EXACT keys; any other id is null, never 0.
- The JSON-path select contract comes from the PostgREST docs and postgrest 2.31.0 and was not probed live. The blob fallback is logged by exception type.
- Failed compares, and calls cancelled by the hard cap or retried by the SDK, are absent, so the figure is neither an upper nor a lower bound of the invoice. The note says so (X12).
- The read is capped at 10 x 1000 rows per window (truncated True).
- metadata.total_cost and /admin/stats/costs are unchanged and are not OpenAI figures.
